raw_response: {"diagnosis": "The new payments-source scheme sends reversals as separate REVERSAL records with orig_txn_id pointing to the original, and no longer updates the original's status. The silver filter keeps only status = 'POSTED', so REVERSAL rows are dropped and the reversed originals (still POSTED) are never netted out, inflating recent-day gold totals from batches 12 onward. The fix is to also exclude any POSTED transaction that has a REVERSAL record referencing it.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.7, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(t.txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, t.customer_id, CAST(t.merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(t.amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(t.txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(t.txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions t WHERE t.status = 'POSTED' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM raw_transactions r WHERE r.status = 'REVERSAL' AND r.orig_txn_id = t.txn_id);"}}
